title: Not so good
text:
Not so good. I reviewed this before. So, this is an update--I never really used it that much before, because I used to live in a small house where there wasn't much room for it.

Now, I've moved in to a house where there IS room, and it is very wobbly on the carpet. Maybe on a tile floor it'd be better.
